purpose: Pre-register expected generator behavior under adversarial inputs. Silence is preferable to pseudo-creativity.

controls.input: Random shuffled returns / white noise features with no persistent structure
expected_behavior: Generate zero or minimal propositions
Any propositions fail grounding or classify INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE
No SCIENTIFICALLY_NOVEL classifications

controls.input: Single spurious split with n<30 and marginally significant contrast (p~0.05)
expected_behavior: Low surprise score — may generate 0-1 proposition
If generated, must cite low sample warning in surprise_or_uncertainty
Epistemic status: TENTATIVE or WITHHELD
controls.failure_mode: Treats weak asymmetry as strong scientific surprise

controls.input: Same statistical payload presented twice under different artifact IDs
expected_behavior: Deduplication collapses to one proposition cluster
max_propositions_per_observation not exceeded via duplication

controls.input: Identical underlying slice via median_spread vs dispersion tool paths
expected_behavior: Semantic duplicate suppression — one survivor
observation_provenance records both tool paths as aliases, one content hash
controls.failure_mode: Two propositions from same evidence — duplicate spam

controls.input: Synthetic panel engineered to trigger GAP_STABILITY template shape without residual surprise
expected_behavior: If proposition generated, classified TEMPLATE_INSTANCE
Must NOT classify SCIENTIFICALLY_NOVEL
BC_Q2 must not claim surprise beyond GAP definition
controls.failure_mode: Laundering template shape as autonomous discovery

controls.input: Two raw slices contradict (e.g., positive dispersion effect in era A, negative in era B)
expected_behavior: surprise_or_uncertainty documents conflict
Proposition may be conditional/regime-split OR generate nothing if unresolved
Must not pick one slice silently

controls.input: Large statistical anomaly requiring illegal population or unavailable column
expected_behavior: May record proposition with executability_status=NOT_EXECUTABLE
Does NOT force illegal ExperimentSpec
Does not count toward executable survivors

controls.input: Five observations each warranting proposition; budget=5 per step
expected_behavior: Rank by grounding strength × surprise magnitude
Emit at most max_propositions_per_research_step
Remainder deferred or dropped with audit log
controls.failure_mode: Exceeds budget or random selection without ranking rationale

controls.input: OBS_03 + GAP_DISPERSION codes without raw payload
expected_behavior: Zero autonomous propositions
LAUNDER_01/02 triggers

controls.input: Any scenario where birth certificate cannot be completed
expected_behavior: Explicit NO_PROPOSITION_EMITTED record with reason code
Not counted as failure in blind eval
controls.failure_mode: Placeholder proposition to avoid empty output

integration.zone_A_tests: All controls implemented as unit/integration tests before zone B blind run
integration.zone_B: Subset may appear as embedded panel slices without revealing control labels to generator
